question: When a portfolio uses LLM segmentation and a document spans pages that start mid-page, how does Sensible fail — silent drop, error, or partial extraction?

searches.query: portfolio LLM segmentation document spans pages mid-page
portfolio segmentation page split error partial extraction

fetched.title: Multi-document extractions
fetched.key_excerpt: Sensible doesn't support segmenting a document that start mid-page in a portfolio. It expects that the first page of each document in a portfolio starts at the top of a page.
